# Apollo

Apollo is a desktop agent from tsc.hk.
Site: https://apollo.tsc.hk
Source: https://github.com/tschk/apollo

The agent that sits on your computer. Setup is a handful of screens: connect a
model, choose a folder, set the rules, try one message. Then a simple chat, or
the full app with several instances, tools, and a history of what happened.
Mac and Linux.
